def decide(bars, account):
    """Trend-following: hold while close is above a rising 200-day average; exit on a 20% break below it or a 30% stop from entry; re-enter on a reclaim of the 200-day average."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 205:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 200-day average"
    ma200 = sum(closes[-200:]) / 200
    ma200_prev = sum(closes[-205:-5]) / 200
    price = closes[-1]
    rising = ma200 > ma200_prev
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price > ma200 and (rising or price > ma200 * 1.02):
            return "BUY", "close above 200-day average with momentum or reclaim"
        return "HOLD", "no entry signal"
    entry = account.get("entry_price")
    if entry is not None and price < entry * 0.70:
        return "SELL", "30% stop from entry hit"
    if price < ma200 * 0.80:
        return "SELL", "close broke 20% below the 200-day average"
    return "HOLD", "trend intact"

def decide(bars, account):
    """Trend-following: hold while close is above a rising 50-day average, exit on a 2% break below it."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    n = len(closes)
    if n < 55:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 50-day average"
    ma50 = sum(closes[-50:]) / 50
    ma50_prev = sum(closes[-55:-5]) / 50
    price = closes[-1]
    rising = ma50 > ma50_prev
    if account["position"] <= 0:
        if price > ma50 and rising:
            return "BUY", "close above rising 50-day average"
        return "HOLD", "no entry signal"
    # exit only on a meaningful break below the average to avoid whipsaw
    if price < ma50 * 0.98:
        return "SELL", "close broke 2% below the 50-day average"
    return "HOLD", "trend intact"

Starting strategy supplied by the researcher and identical for every run; you did not write it. It is deliberately simple. Judge it on the evidence like any other version.
def decide(bars, account):
    """Seed strategy: hold the stock while its close is above the 20-day average."""
    closes = bars["close"]
    if len(closes) < 20:
        return "HOLD", "not enough history for a 20-day average"
    average = sum(closes[-20:]) / 20
    price = closes[-1]
    if account["position"] <= 0 and price > average:
        return "BUY", "close is above the 20-day average"
    if account["position"] > 0 and price < average:
        return "SELL", "close is below the 20-day average"
    return "HOLD", "no change"

2024-W442024-11-04REVISE → rejectedv001+0.00%+3.23%-3.21The seed strategy is a pure 20-day MA crossover that is currently flat while the stock rallied +3.23% in a single day, and a 20-day MA whipsaws badly on a low-volatility large-cap like XOM, generating many trades and missing trend legs. The specific flaw: it exits on any close below a short average, so it sits out of strong uptrends and pays commission on noise. I replace it with a slower, trend-following filter: hold while close is above the 100-day average AND the 50-day average is above the 100-day average (a regime filter), which keeps the position through normal pullbacks and only exits on genuine trend breaks. This reduces churn and should capture more of the buy&hold upside while still cutting drawdowns. [backtest failed: fewer than 10 trading days of history to backtest on]
